Amelia Roberts is a UFS student and researcher.


Personality
She is an extremely unemotional person only interested in research, she is called weird and on the extreme end of the anti-social researcher scale.

Amelia has a tendency to look into empty space, even when talking to other people. She isn't shy about sex and if needed for her biology studies she will perform the tests herself. Almost always sleepy, but in truth, her mind is constantly thinking about very immoral experimentation. Her greatest desire is to resurrect her dead mother.

Appearance
She has blond hair and yellow eyes.

History
Background
Amelia is a normal human student going to an academy. She is specializing in biology and is also a researcher for the UFS.

She lost her mother at a young age, became determent to bring her mother back alive, with her research. As she is confronted that bringing back the dead is impossible, she becomes just more determent in her research. In the end, she learns about demons and Taimanin, and hopes to collect samples, which she could use to gain the power to resurrect the dead.

Timeline TABA
In the artbook it is stated, she became fascinated by Fuuma Kotaro (TABA)'s Evil Eye: Demonic Gate, which could steal abilities and in the hope to gain knowledge she started to work with the Fuuma Organization, willing to give her own body to one day obtain the ability.

In her "what if", asks, an unknown person, to help with her research into the reproduction of humans.


Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Mind

Smart
Vibroscissors & Scalpels: Amelia's favorite scissors and scalpel. Its ultra-high frequency vibration function makes it extremely sharp, so it can cut through demons with diamond-like skins or tough protective suits.
